title: MultiblockCore Manual
summary: Read blueprints, complete structures, install upgrades, and keep automation tasks understandable.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: MultiblockCore supports larger structures without making players memorize every block. Blueprints and progress data turn facility construction into a readable checklist.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Place one blueprint, gather its exact block family, and finish the base structure before worrying about upgrades or automation.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Discover a blueprint, place the structure, validate missing blocks, complete the multiblock, then install upgrades that match the job.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Definitions describe shape, progression entries describe unlocks, upgrade definitions alter behavior, and task recipes connect structures to automation goals.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Blockworks helps mark footprints, Logistics stages required blocks, PowerGrid feeds machines, and Index can expose structure or task references.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a structure will not validate, check orientation, block variants, controller position, required air spaces, and whether the blueprint belongs to the loaded addon set.
